cases.name: pathfinding-editing-tools-protect-and-move-endpoints
cases.purpose: All four editing tools act through published cells, protect distinct endpoints and clear walls when moving an endpoint.

cases.name: pathfinding-bfs-and-astar-find-the-same-shortest-detour
cases.purpose: A* and BFS find the same known five-step detour, avoid the obstacle and expose their explored counts.

cases.name: pathfinding-default-maze-produces-a-contiguous-shortest-route
cases.purpose: Both algorithms solve the shipped maze with equal shortest distances and a contiguous non-branching visible route.

cases.name: pathfinding-unreachable-finishes-and-reset-preserves-terrain
cases.purpose: An unreachable map terminates explicitly; reset preserves terrain and endpoints, and the preset restores its barriers.

cases.name: pathfinding-animation-pauses-resumes-edits-and-isolates-mounts
cases.purpose: Actual animation timers advance, pause and resume; live edits and algorithm changes restart safely without affecting a peer instance.

cases.name: pathfinding-hidden-and-replaced-mounts-stop-old-animation
cases.purpose: Hidden boards automatically pause and an obsolete timer cannot publish into a replacement mount.

cases.name: pathfinding-keyboard-controls-and-coordinate-navigation
cases.purpose: The command loop routes arrows, RET, TAB, play/pause, step, reset and close to the documented visible controls.

cases.name: pathfinding-animation-step-is-one-local-publication
cases.purpose: The public performance report proves one bounded local text/paint publication per warm animation step with no full-root or scope fallback.

cases.name: etaf-playground-mount-rejects-unknown-example
cases.purpose: An unknown example fails explicitly without publishing preview content.

cases.name: etaf-playground-mounts-preloaded-research-companion
cases.purpose: A directly loaded source or compiled Research Shelf companion mounts repeatedly without duplicate Action registration and its Reload control remains functional.

cases.name: etaf-playground-mounts-static-rule-companion-in-fresh-emacs
cases.purpose: Research Shelf mounts, filters, paginates and switches light/dark themes through public APIs with its scoped ECSS companion and an isolated database.

cases.name: etaf-playground-mounts-desktop-with-provider-feature-loaded
cases.purpose: Mounting the desktop example works when the etaf-desktop provider feature is already loaded, so the companion still registers and builds its root instead of falling back to a missing etaf-desktop-root.

cases.name: etaf-playground-consumes-etaf-desktop-application
cases.purpose: The Playground mounts the independent ETAF Desktop application as a consumer and releases it through the public workspace lifecycle.

cases.name: task-workbench-draft-validates-saves-cancels-and-isolates-instances
cases.purpose: Editing only changes a draft until save; navigation resolves pending edits.

cases.name: task-workbench-async-search-supersedes-cancels-and-times-out
cases.purpose: Search retires and restores selected details, renders current paint and empty states, rejects stale completion, and recovers from cancellation and timeout.

cases.name: task-workbench-async-save-retries-only-known-failures
cases.purpose: Pending writes disable duplicate saves; known failures preserve the draft.

cases.name: task-workbench-committed-refresh-and-unknown-write-recovery
cases.purpose: Read recovery preserves the saved revision without repeating writes; later independent reads report their own failures and cancellation.

cases.name: task-workbench-closing-pending-save-preserves-another-instance
cases.purpose: Closing a Workbench during a pending write cannot revive it or replace another instance draft.

cases.name: task-workbench-edit-delete-and-filter-retire-detail-controls
cases.purpose: Deleting an edited selection removes its detail controls while subsequent filters and another selection remain usable.

cases.name: task-workbench-row-menu-edits-and-confirms-deletion
cases.purpose: Task row menus open editing, protect incomplete tasks and delete exactly one task after confirmation.
